statusText: Conditions stay tradable as the 13:30 UTC cash open goes live; the July PPI print has already been digested calmly, VIX sits in the mid-14s, and Tail remains low with no confirmed post-open price-path evidence yet available, while Stress ticks up on the live open, the unresolved Hormuz backdrop and pending Applied Materials earnings
recommendation: Current action remains EA_ON. Reassess through the remainder of the 13:30-14:30 UTC cash-open window as confirmed post-open ticks become available, and again around Applied Materials after-close earnings (~20:30 UTC); an upgrade to a higher Tail state requires observed persistent one-way structure with failed pullbacks after the open, not the open itself or the absence of fresh data.
headline: Nasdaq cash open goes live with no confirmed post-bell print yet; a calmly digested PPI print and VIX in the mid-14s keep Tail low while the Hormuz standoff persists as an unresolved background risk
body: The Bureau of Labor Statistics July Producer Price Index, released at 12:30 UTC, was unchanged on a seasonally adjusted basis versus a Dow Jones consensus of +0.2%, with core PPI confirming the softer, disinflationary tone that followed Wednesdays in-line CPI report; this has already been digested calmly through the premarket session. The 13:30 UTC cash open has now begun (this assessment is generated roughly 5-7 minutes after the bell), but neither Alpha Vantage intraday equity endpoint nor available web reporting yet reflects a confirmed fresh post-open tick print -- the NQ premarket range (~29,668-30,002, last near 29,806) and QQQ Aug 12 regular-session close (723.70, +0.73%) remain the latest directly evidenced levels, so post-open continuation or reversal cannot yet be confirmed from direct evidence either way. The VIX was last near 14.68, down from an earlier 15.29 open, consistent with volatility compression into the print rather than event-proximity stress, though this reading also predates the open. The 10-year Treasury yield was last available near 4.70% and the 2-year near 4.22% (Alpha Vantages most recent daily print, dated Aug 11, is now two sessions stale). WTI crude was last available near $84.77/bbl (also dated Aug 11). Irans Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters reiterated today that no commercial vessel can safely transit the Strait of Hormuz without Irans permission, and Tehran continues to condition reopening on unmet demands -- a reaffirmation of the existing standoff rather than a fresh escalatory shock with new market transmission, so it stays an unresolved elevated background risk rather than a discontinuity. This runs Alpha Vantage MARKET_STATUS and TOP_GAINERS_LOSERS calls both returned Cloudflare 502 errors after one retry each, so breadth/leadership and a direct market-status confirmation could not be pulled from the feed this run; open status is inferred from the known Thursday NYSE calendar rather than a live check. Applied Materials still reports fiscal Q3 earnings after todays close (~20:30 UTC), a potential catalyst for tomorrows session, with consensus near $3.39 EPS on ~$9B revenue. Given the lack of confirmed post-open price-path evidence, Tail stays low at 15%, unchanged from the prior hour. Stress ticks up to 51%, reflecting the cash open now being live/in-progress alongside the unresolved Hormuz backdrop and pending AMAT earnings, not any observed pathological structure. Confidence is set lower at 47% to reflect both the stale Treasury/oil prints and this runs Alpha Vantage MARKET_STATUS/TOP_GAINERS_LOSERS failures.

outlookSummary: The next 24 hours stay tradable under the Tail rule. Forecast Tail stays in the mid-teens through most of the window, with a mild bump into the low-to-mid 50s on Stress around the now-live 13:30 UTC cash open, again around Applied Materials after-close earnings reaction (~20:30-21:00 UTC), and once more heading into tomorrows 12:30 UTC Retail Sales print. None of these bumps cross the WATCH threshold on this runs evidence; an upgrade requires observed post-catalyst continuation with failed retracements, not the catalyst itself or a lack of confirming data.

First full hour of cash trading is the key structural test; Stress stays elevated on positioning risk into and just after the open, not on any observed persistent one-way move. A clean two-way session pulls Tail back toward premarket levels quickly.
Opening-hour follow-through determines whether the soft-PPI tailwind extends or fades; no failed-retracement pattern has been observed yet from available evidence.
Midday digestion; absent confirmed repeated extension after the open, Stress should retreat further as the PPI/cash-open catalyst cluster clears.
Afternoon session normalizes further with no fresh scheduled catalyst until Applied Materials reports after todays close.
